entries.title: Starting a task applies your standing directions
entries.body: When you press Start, drag a task to Working or queue it, the task shows Starting while Firstmate applies the directions that fit it, then it begins. A task set to merge on its own now merges after its checks pass, without asking you to click.
entries.noPicture: The change is Firstmate's behavior and a task's history lines; there is no new screen to photograph.
